title: Maurya Empire
description: Emperor Ashoka sent his son, Mahinda Thero, and later his daughter, Sanghamitta Theri, to Sri Lanka to introduce Buddhism.
biography: The Maurya Empire was a geographically extensive Iron Age historical power based in Magadha and founded by Chandragupta Maurya. Under Ashoka the Great, the empire embraced Buddhism and spread its teachings across Asia, including to Sri Lanka through his son Mahinda.

sections.heading: Connection to Sri Lanka

This event fundamentally transformed Sri Lankan culture, architecture, and governance.

title: Ruhuna
description: Founded around 200 BC by Prince Mahanaga after a dispute with his brother, King Devanampiya Tissa of Anuradhapura.
